title: Anthropic's Agentic Marketplace Vision
caption:
Your next online purchase might not involve a human at all. Anthropic is pushing a vision where AI agents handle everything from product discovery to checkout.

This shift means unprecedented efficiency, but also new competitive landscapes.

Tap to BUILD for the field guide on agentic AI.

slides.headline: Why your next online purchase won't be from a human
slides.sub: The rise of AI agent marketplaces.

slides.definition: Platforms where autonomous AI agents interact, negotiate, and execute transactions on behalf of users or businesses, from product discovery to purchase.
slides.example: A user's agent finds and buys the best flight, hotel, and car rental package without direct human input.

slides.title: Agents aren't just chatbots.
bullets: Autonomous: They act without constant human instruction.
Goal-Oriented: Given a task, they break it down and execute steps.
Interactive: They communicate with other agents and systems.
slides.footer: They represent you in a digital economy.

slides.postStat: of online transactions will involve AI agents acting autonomously.
slides.body: This isn't just automation; it's delegation at scale. Agents handle complex, multi-step tasks, freeing up human time for higher-value work.

audiences.body: Reduced operational costs, hyper-personalized customer experiences, expanded reach without human scaling limits.
Time saved, better deals, tailored services. Your agent becomes your personal shopper, travel agent, and negotiator.
Traditional brokers, comparison sites, and even some content creators face disruption as agents bypass them.

slides.title: The Road Ahead for Agentic AI

cards.title: Autonomous Commerce
cards.body: Agents will move beyond simple tasks to handle entire complex transactions, acting as digital brokers.

cards.title: Trust & Ethics
cards.body: Ensuring agents operate ethically and transparently is crucial for widespread adoption and user confidence.

cards.title: New Market Models
cards.body: Expect entirely new marketplaces and services designed for agent-to-agent interaction, not just human users.

cards.title: Regulatory Scrutiny
cards.body: Governments will likely introduce regulations to manage agent autonomy, liability, and data privacy implications.

slides.hook: Agentic AI is coming faster than you think.
slides.sub: Get the full breakdown on AI agent architecture and deployment.
